data_qc: The design storms are derived from the gauge record after quality control. The record in data/climate/ is the raw logger export; the operator's station maintenance log is supplied with it.
annual_maxima: for each calendar year 1994-2013 and each duration D in idf_durations_min: the maximum sum of D/5 consecutive 5-minute depths of the quality-controlled series. A calendar year enters the annual-maxima series only if at least 90 % of its 5-minute intervals hold valid data; in the years that are kept, intervals without valid data count as 0 mm.
distribution: Gumbel EV1, method of moments per duration: depth(T,D) = mean_D + K_T * std_D, std with ddof=1, K_T = -(sqrt(6)/pi) * (0.5772156649 + ln(ln(T/(T-1))))
interpolation: depth between fitted durations: linear interpolation of ln(depth) against ln(duration), after forcing ln(depth) to be non-decreasing with duration (cumulative maximum)
hyetograph: alternating block, 5-min blocks: block depths are the increments of depth(T, 5k) for k = 1..D/5; sorted descending; the largest block is placed at index round(peak_fraction*n - 0.5) (clipped to [0, n-1]); remaining blocks alternate right, left, right, ... around it, spilling to the free side when one side is full; each depth rounded to 0.001 mm
simulation: Use the coupled as-built network and operating scenarios in engineering_contract.md and tools/hydraulics.py; simulate 48 hours beyond the last rain block, with recovery measured at 24 hours.
